reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend with a holidays parameter, but the daily-skip checks keep their own inline weekend tests and the budget schedule template call sites are not given holidays.

duplication.why: The 'weekend or holiday' predicate (isWeekend || holidays.includes(dayFromDate)) is written inline five times: twice in getNextDate, in getUpcomingDates, in getDatesInRange and in getDateWithSkippedWeekend, instead of one shared non-working-day function.

placement.why: The movement rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, but the daily-skip rule is re-decided in server/schedules/app.ts helpers rather than in the shared module.

scope.why: Focused on holidays, though it also adds a new daily-weekend filter to getUpcomingDates that was not there before.

maintainability.why: Each site decides on its own whether a day is non-working and when to apply the rule, and schedule-template.ts still calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend without holidays, so the rule is already inconsistent.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline holiday predicates in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate and server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates/getDatesInRange are open copies, not reshaped.

one_place.where: Holiday handling is added separately in getNextDate (two finds), getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and getDateWithSkippedWeekend; server/budget/schedule-template.ts calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend without holidays.
